answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Social-graph flow limits: each identity may endorse only 5 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 860 aliases need 860 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches. A cluster that endorses only itself collapses to a single share. A oasis of doubt is healthy, a jetty of proof is required, and a nectar of patience is the price of a clean panel. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
